directory.title: Find a clinic and book online
directory.lead: Search clinics that use {brand} by specialty, city and insurance — and see the next free appointment at a glance.
directory.meta_description: Find a clinic, compare the next free appointment and book online in a minute. {n} clinics on {brand}.
directory.meta_specialty: {specialty} clinics on {brand}: see the next free appointment and book online.
directory.online_only_help: Only clinics with doctors who see patients by video
directory.next_none: No free times in the next {n} days
directory.empty_text: Try another city or specialty, or clear the filters.
directory.none_text: Clinics that use {brand} can list themselves here. Check back soon.
directory.for_clinics_link: List it in the directory with {brand}
directory.settings_sub: List your clinic in the public directory so patients can find it by specialty, city and insurance and book your next free time.
directory.toggle_label: List my clinic in the {brand} directory
directory.off_confirm: Your clinic will no longer appear in the {brand} directory. Patients can still book on your own clinic page.
directory.on_done: Your clinic is listed in the {brand} directory.
directory.off_done: Your clinic was removed from the directory.
directory.shown_text: Patients see your logo, name, specialty, city, doctors' names, accepted insurance and your next free appointment. Patient data is never shown.
directory.waiting_text: Your clinic appears once everything below is ready.
directory.check_city: City is filled in (for the city search)
directory.check_specialty: Specialty is chosen (for the specialty search)

widget.title: Booking button & links
widget.lead: Put a booking button on your website, share tracked booking links and list your clinic in the {brand} directory — and see where your bookings come from.
widget.need_slug: Set your clinic page address first — the button and links open your booking page.
widget.booking_off: Online booking is off. The button and links show “booking unavailable” until you turn it on.
widget.embed_sub: Paste this line into your website, just before </body>. A floating “Book an appointment” button opens your booking page over your site.
widget.button_sub: For website builders that don't accept scripts: a normal link that looks like a button.
widget.preview_note: The button appears in the bottom corner of this page — click it to try your booking page.
widget.origins_label: Websites allowed to show the booking page
widget.origins_help: One address per line, e.g. https://www.myclinic.com. Leave empty to allow any website.
widget.links_sub: Each link opens your booking page and records where the booking came from. See the results in Reports → Bookings & no-shows.
widget.where_qr: QR code on the door, cards and printouts
widget.qr_title: QR code for the clinic door and printouts
widget.qr_sub: Patients scan it with the phone camera to book. These bookings count as “QR code”.
widget.qr_alt: QR code that opens the booking page

channels.lead: Where bookings come from and how reliably patients attend — per doctor and per channel.
channels.per_doctor_sub: Only visits that were due count: completed or no-show.
channels.by_channel_sub: Count, share, attendance and no-shows per channel.
channels.trend_sub: Booked online by patients vs booked by staff, per week (by visit date).
